# bq-skeleton



<!-- Auto Generated Below -->


## Overview

The Skeleton component is a visual placeholder that previews where content will appear while it loads.

## Properties

| Property | Attribute | Description                                  | Type                                | Default       |
| -------- | --------- | -------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------- | ------------- |
| `effect` | `effect`  | The animation effect applied to the skeleton | `"none" \| "pulse" \| "sheen"`      | `'none'`      |
| `height` | `height`  | The skeleton height                          | `string`                            | `'1rem'`      |
| `shape`  | `shape`   | The skeleton shape                           | `"circle" \| "rectangle" \| "text"` | `'rectangle'` |
| `width`  | `width`   | The skeleton width                           | `string`                            | `'100%'`      |


## Shadow Parts

| Part          | Description                                                         |
| ------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `"indicator"` | The skeleton indicator responsible for color, shape, and animation. |
